title: The selection and block arithmetic map on the functorial Roos complex
statement: For an abelian category with countable products and a cochain complex X of strict towers, arithmeticRoosMap X e he is the actual signed Roos cochain map from X to its e-subsequence, induced by selection on one product and finite transition-block sums on the other, for e≥1 [def-sp-strict-tower-arithmetic-restriction-data].

def arithmeticRoosMap
    {A : Type x} [Category.{y} A] [Abelian A] [HasCountableProducts A]
    (X : CochainComplex (ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ A) ℤ) (e : ℕ) (he : 1 ≤ e) :
    roosF.obj X ⟶ roosF.obj ((complexRestriction A e).obj X)
